in_marathi.name: Nimitraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift, Grace, God's Will
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimitraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nimitraj is derived from Sanskrit roots 'Nimita' meaning 'sign' and 'Raj' meaning 'rule' or 'reign'. The name refers to one who is bestowed with divine grace or is a sign of God's will.
